summary: Marine Sgt. Krystle Williams, 25, fell ~20 ft on the rain-slicked north side of Horsetooth Rock on a Tuesday afternoon, breaking her tibia in three places and shattering her L5 vertebra; 45 rescuers (PFA, LCSAR, parks, PVH EMS) worked 4+ hours in steady rain to lower her in a multi-rope system to the trailhead and an ambulance; she survived, hospitalized at Medical Center of the Rockies
location: Horsetooth Rock (north side), Horsetooth Mountain Park, west of Fort Collins
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Larimer County parks; Poudre Valley Hospital EMS
notes: Beaconjournal 2015-07-18 follow-up feature confirms date July 7 and identity; larimer.org PDF preserves the original 2015-07-07 Coloradoan story; date weekday-verified Tuesday; same incident as the 'Horsetooth Rock fall prompts rescue' 7/7 report
